mach.join.unreachable: No public URL is configured, so this command uses the current page address ({address}). Only machines that can reach it (usually just this computer) can join. To connect remote machines, set "Public URL" in Settings first.
mach.join.step1: On that machine, install tycho as the regular user who will run tasks (not root or Administrator), then run:
mach.join.step2: The command prints a 6-digit code and waits, and the machine appears below under "Machines waiting for admission". Enter the 6-digit code below or click "Admit" in the sidebar to verify and approve it. If WeCom is configured, you can also approve from your phone. Localhost joins on the host itself are admitted automatically.
mach.join.step3: After admission, the command prints "Joined" and stays running in that terminal (closing it disconnects the machine). To run in the background on startup, run {cmd} on that machine. Its card will appear here as Connected, and its installed executors will be reported shortly.
mach.join.codeMismatch: The 6-digit code does not match this machine. Check the code shown on its screen.
mach.join.pendingHint: Machines running the join command appear here. Enter the 6-digit code shown on the machine to admit it, or click "Admit" in the sidebar.
mach.join.pendingEmpty: No machines are waiting for admission. Run the join command above on a machine and it will appear here.
mach.removal.revokeDesc: Once revoked, it cannot reconnect or accept new work. This record remains to show how it ended.
mach.removal.deleteRecordDesc: Its registration has already ended. This only removes the remaining record.
mach.removal.deleteDesc: The service will stop dispatching work to it, and its local logins will be removed from project allowlists. To use it again, re-join on that machine as a new machine.
mach.invite.title: Join quotas
mach.invite.desc: Quotas requested by tasks to spawn new machines. New machines join with one-time material and only accept scoped work. Revoking stops new material and invalidates unused material without affecting already joined machines.
